definition.interpretation: Declared subjective sensitivity model, not calibrated probabilities or confidence bounds. Parameters are fixed before the current price comparison.
limitations: A weighted online poll is not an IID probability sample. Design effects and error terms are judgment assumptions; microdata and effective sample size were not supplied.
The fundamentals and poll may be correlated. Pool standard deviations are added with positive correlation, rather than precision-fusing them as independent evidence.
Future opinion drift runs from the original field end to election day, including days that have not happened yet.
All independent support is assigned to a single opponent in the comparator. Unforeseen candidate shocks, turnout changes and sponsor treatment remain possible.
The broader stress family can contradict the ordinary scenario edge. A small official pilot can test execution, but cannot validate an election forecast before settlement.
No market price or DDHQ win probability enters the assessment. There is no claimed near-term price reversion.
